name: Canonicalize and standardize logs
goal: Establish one canonical logging model for SYNTH: consolidate CLI error logs (cli-errors.jsonl), runtime diagnostics, event logs, and proof/temp artifacts into a single location, consistent schema, and rotation policy. Eliminate ad-hoc/duplicate logs (e.g., cli-errors.jsonl vs a referenced cli-errors.log, per-test temp logs under /var/folders) and standardize structured stdout vs diagnostic streams so operators and tooling depend on one shape.
